base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y git curl clang llvm libbpf-dev libelf-dev protobuf-compiler cmake libssl-dev gcc-multilib pkg-config
source $HOME/.cargo/env && rustup toolchain install nightly --profile minimal
source $HOME/.cargo/env && rustup component add rust-src --toolchain nightly

runtime_profile.notes: Project requires both stable and nightly Rust toolchains. eBPF programs require libbpf, clang, and llvm. Socket directories /run/bpfman-sock and /run/bpfman/csi must be created at runtime by the RPC binary.

notes: bpfman is a Linux-only eBPF program manager requiring systemd for journal logging. The fix involves socket directory creation (/run/bpfman-sock, /run/bpfman/csi) and logging initialization in RPC and CLI binaries. Git and curl are included in system packages. The project uses cargo workspace with xtask for custom build tasks.
